text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, McQueen! Wanna play baseball
together?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You go to games pretty regularly, right?
I need a
teammate, so I figured you'd be
the one to ask!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I happened to hear you talking to
Golshi, that's
all! ♪ A fan like you
must've played a game or
two, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Urgh... Well, you're not exactly wrong...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then let's play! That should be just as
fun as
watching, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Especially when you hit the ball! The
sound of the
metal bat colliding with the
ball is the best! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
W-well... I suppose you leave me with no
choice
but to—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yippee! We needed an umpire to play,
so this is
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Umpire?! Now hold on! The umpire
doesn't get to
hit the ball at all!
